product.name: BIK Chatbot
product.description: An AI-driven chatbot that automates customer interactions across multiple social channels to assist users from initial query to purchase completion.

product.name: Multi-Channel Helpdesk Support
product.description: A centralized customer support platform that manages queries from multiple communication channels to improve response times and customer satisfaction.

product.name: Store Automation
product.description: An automation tool that engages website visitors based on their activity to capture leads and convert them through preferred communication channels.

product.name: WhatsApp Marketing
product.description: A platform for creating and sending personalized, multimedia WhatsApp campaigns to engage customers and recover abandoned carts.

product.name: BIK Campaigns
product.description: A multichannel marketing campaign tool that segments customers and broadcasts personalized messages to optimize marketing efforts.

product.name: BIK Integrations
product.description: A service that connects BIK’s platform with various third-party applications to unify customer data and streamline marketing efforts.
